paper.title_en: Modeling the LISA response in the time-frequency domain
paper.abstract_en: Time-frequency methods are a promising approach to LISA data analysis. This paper presents a model for the LISA response directly in the time-frequency domain using the Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer (WDM) transformation. The implementation is vectorized using JAX and can efficiently evaluate the response for batches of signals, achieving white-noise mismatches of $\sim 10^{-9}$ compared to existing implementations of the LISA one-arm response. Our results demonstrate that the LISA response can be modeled accurately and efficiently in the time-frequency domain, providing an important component of an end-to-end time-frequency LISA analysis framework.
